content.text: I added keyboard input and a SCI key that opens a panel with √x, x² and 1/x. The keyboard presses the matching on-screen key, and √x, x² and 1/x work on the shown value like ± does. `9 √` shows 3, and bad results like √ of a negative or 1/0 show Error. There are no checks in `check/`, and all the code is inside the page, so I couldn't test it without a stub. I made sure the script parses and read through the earlier features; nothing was broken, so I fixed nothing. I rejected closing the panel on AC (not asked) and ignoring Shift, since `+` and `*` need it.
